title: Execution Policy
summary: Decide which tool actions may run, which require a human or policy decision, and which must be constrained by an operating-system boundary.

agent_implementations.notes: Substantial coverage describes a clearly documented negative boundary, not a built-in sandbox implementation.

open_questions: Which decisions belong to semantic permissions and which require OS enforcement?
How should approval caches be scoped and revoked?
How can headless execution fail closed without making automation unusable?
